name: Sasaki Ryuu
source:
Ryuu grew up in the same neighborhood as Mikuru and Toshiro, and all 3 are very close. When they were in high school, Ryuu wound up in a horrible accident, and had to be held back a year. He is still wrestling with with the unresolved trauma from that, and the permanent injury to his right leg.

Favorite Color: Red
Blood Type: O+
